steps.en: Download the single-file binary for your OS and run it
steps.zh: 下载对应系统的单文件可执行程序并运行

steps.en: Plug in a supported USB adapter, pick it on the splash, click START
steps.zh: 插上受支持的 USB 网卡，在启动页选中它，点 START

steps.en: Binds the adapter to userland once, sidestepping the OS Wi-Fi stack entirely
steps.zh: 一次性把网卡绑到用户态，绕开系统 Wi-Fi 栈

steps.en: Its Python mini-driver claims the chip over USB, loads the vendor firmware, and sets monitor mode
steps.zh: 迷你驱动经 USB 接管芯片，上传厂商固件并写入监听模式

steps.en: Channel-hops 2.4/5 GHz, aggregates all adapters, and lists APs with vendor/model fingerprints
steps.zh: 在 2.4/5 GHz 跳频扫描，聚合多卡，把 AP 指纹到品牌型号

steps.en: Focus one AP and start a campaign: deauth, PMKID, WPS, WEP, or EvilTwin
steps.zh: 聚焦 AP，发起战役：解除认证、PMKID、WPS、WEP、EvilTwin

steps.en: Injects the 802.11 frames in pure Python, validates captures, and stores them in the Vault
steps.zh: 纯 Python 注入组帧，存入 Vault

value.en: A crackable WPA hash from a Windows or macOS laptop — no Kali VM, no kernel drivers, no aircrack-ng
value.zh: Windows 或 macOS 上直接拿到可破解的 WPA 哈希——不用 Kali、内核驱动或 aircrack-ng
